password.title: Set a password.
password.lede: You are already signed in on this device. Add a password, or use your Google account, and you can also open your portal from your phone or another computer.
password.emailHint: Already confirmed, we won't ask you again.

hint.default: Eight characters or more. Use something you will remember.

password.notNow: Not now, take me back to my application
notes: Your account and any documents you upload are held confidentially by the firm and visible only to the people working on your case.
You can stop at any point. Nothing is submitted to any authority until you tell us to.

reset.title: Choose a new password.
reset.lede: Your link worked and you are signed in on this device. Choose a new password for the email below. Every other device will need to sign in again.

errors.rejected: That password is not accepted. Choose a longer or less common one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.

signIn.title: Follow your case.

lede.form: Sign in to see where your application stands, add documents, or continue where you left off.
lede.reset: Enter the email you registered and we will send you a link to set a new password.

signIn.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.

noAccount.known: Your application and documents are waiting. Signing in never asks you to fill anything in twice.
noAccount.unknown: No application yet? Start with the eligibility check and your portal opens automatically at the end.

hints.invalid: We could not match that email and password. Check both, or use Forgot it? to reset.
hints.noPassword: No password is set on this application yet. Continue with Google, or use Forgot it? to set one now.

signIn.sent: We sent a reset link to <bdi>{email}</bdi>. It is valid for one hour.

notice.link: That link is no longer valid. Use Forgot it? below to get a new one.
notice.accountExists: This email address already has a sign-in account. Sign in with its password, or use Forgot it? below and we will email you a link.
notice.oauth: We could not complete the sign-in with Google. Please try again, or use your email and password.
notice.googleUnavailable: Sign in with Google is not available right now. Please use your email and password.
notice.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
notice.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
notice.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.

linkExpired.title: This link has expired.
linkExpired.lede: Links in our emails stop working after 60 days, or after you open one on a different device. Enter the email on your file and we will send you a fresh one.
linkExpired.sent: If that address is on file, a new link is on its way. Check your inbox.

unsubscribe.title: Stop these emails?
unsubscribe.lede: You will no longer receive our follow-up emails about your eligibility check. Messages about your case itself, such as call confirmations and status updates, still reach you.
unsubscribe.error: We could not complete that just now. Please try again.

done.title: You are unsubscribed.
done.lede: We will not send you any more of these emails.

invalid.title: This link is not valid.
invalid.lede: Open the unsubscribe link in the email again and make sure the whole address was used.

portal.title: Open your portal.
portal.lede: Press the button to continue. Your progress is exactly where you left it.

reset.title: Choose a new password.
reset.lede: Press the button to open the page where you set your new password.

verify.title: Enter your code.
verify.lede: Open the authenticator app on your phone and type the 6-digit code for this account.
verify.invalid: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check the clock on your phone and try the next code.
verify.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
verify.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
verify.noFactor: No authenticator app is set up for this account. Sign out and sign in again.

setup.title: Two-step verification

lede.off: Protect the CRM with an authenticator app. After your password the CRM asks for a 6-digit code from your phone, so a stolen password alone opens nothing.
lede.required: The firm requires two-step verification. Set up an authenticator app to continue to the CRM.
lede.on: Two-step verification is on. Signing in to the CRM asks for the code from your authenticator app.

setup.scanLede: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password and others), then type the 6-digit code it shows.
setup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.secretLabel: Cannot scan? Type this key into the app
setup.invalid: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check the clock on your phone and try the next code.
setup.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
setup.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
setup.done: Two-step verification is on. From now on the CRM asks for a code after your password.
setup.turnOffAsk: Turn it off? The CRM will ask for your password only.
setup.turnOffRequired: The firm requires two-step verification, so it cannot be turned off here.
